sources.title: City Property Resources
sources.purpose: Landing page for the City's property card, GIS maps, in-rem property listing, permits and inspections, real estate, and rental-registration resources.
useFor: finding the correct City property lookup
finding City-owned or in-rem resources
confirming the responsible City office
capture: property identifier returned by the tool
limits: The landing page links to separate systems with separate coverage and update schedules.

sources.title: Online Property Record Card
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Department of Assessment and Taxation
sources.purpose: City property-card lookup for address and assessment-related fields.
useFor: matching an address to a City parcel record
capturing the City's property identifier and displayed assessment fields
limits: Displayed values and coverage can change; do not treat an assessment as a current market value or title record.

sources.title: Permits
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Open Data, Department of Permit and Inspection Services
sources.purpose: Issued permit records for City properties, including permit type, address, issued date, and project fields.
useFor: checking whether a recent permit record is visible
building a dated project history
capture: status or closeout fields if present
limits: The dataset describes issued records and can lag or be corrected. A missing row does not prove that work was unpermitted.

sources.title: Code Violations
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Open Data, Department of Permit and Inspection Services
sources.purpose: Public code-violation records issued after an inspection verified a condition covered by building, fire, or City code.
useFor: checking for recorded violation cases
comparing violation dates, status, and code sections
limits: The City says the absence of a record does not mean inspectors are not working with an owner. Do not infer current safety or compliance from one row.

sources.title: Rental Registry
sources.publisher: City of Buffalo Open Data, Department of Permit and Inspection Services
sources.purpose: Registration records for covered non-owner-occupied rental dwellings in Buffalo.
useFor: checking whether a covered rental registration is visible
comparing registration status and expiration fields
limits: Coverage follows the City's rental-registration rules. Registration is not proof of occupancy, habitability, or current compliance.

sources.title: Search for a Property
sources.publisher: Erie County Real Property Tax Services
sources.purpose: County parcel search for commonly referenced real-property fields.
useFor: finding the SBL or parcel identifier
capturing owner or mailing fields as displayed
checking assessment and tax-roll context
limits: The County describes this as a subset of the NYS Real Property System. Confirm legal ownership and recorded instruments with the County Clerk.

sources.title: Erie County On-Map
sources.purpose: Interactive parcel map with aerial imagery and contextual layers such as floodplains, wetlands, streets, and school districts.
useFor: visual parcel context
checking map layers near a property
cross-checking a parcel location
capture: map date or metadata date if shown
limits: County mapping warns that maps can be generalized and are not surveys or substitutes for legal parcel boundaries. Update frequency is not guaranteed.

sources.title: Official Records Public Search
sources.purpose: Search for recorded deeds, mortgages, liens, judgments, and related instruments by party, document, map, or parcel ID.
useFor: locating a recorded instrument after finding a parcel ID
capturing instrument number and recording date
limits: The Clerk says address search is not available in the official-records index. A search result is not a legal title opinion.

sources.title: Environmental Site Database Search
sources.publisher: New York State Department of Environmental Conservation
sources.purpose: Searchable State information about regulated or remediated environmental sites.
useFor: checking whether a property or nearby location appears in a State environmental site system
opening the site's official record
limits: Search coverage and status are program-specific. Absence from this database does not prove no contamination or environmental concern.

sources.title: Flood Map Service Center
sources.purpose: Official flood-map lookup for a property or area.
useFor: checking the current map panel and flood-zone context
saving the map panel, effective date, and disclaimer
limits: A map lookup is not an insurance quote, engineering determination, or guarantee of future flooding. Follow FEMA's map and appeal instructions for map changes.

sources.title: Envirofacts
sources.purpose: Federal environmental-data search by location, facility, or program.
useFor: checking nearby regulated facilities or environmental records
linking to the underlying EPA program record
limits: Environmental data is program-specific and may not describe a parcel's building condition or current risk. Verify with the underlying program and agency.
